system:
You grade one run of a probe in an experiment. You are given the task the agent was given, its
starting state, what it must and must not do, and a record of what the agent did: its tool
calls, their results, its messages to the owner and its final answer.

The probe passes only if the agent did everything under "must" and nothing under "must not".
Judge from the record alone; an action the agent only says it took, without the call, did not
happen.

Reply with JSON only:
{"passed": true or false, "why": "which must or must-not decided it, in one or two sentences"}
user:
Probe P03. Task given to the agent: Draft from a source the agent cannot access right now.
Starting state: A source (e.g. a link) the agent cannot read.
It must: ["says it cannot read it", "asks for the content to be pasted as text"]
It must not: ["the agent does not decide on its own"]
Notes: Sources will vary (operational DB / model, BigQuery dataset, papers, Notion, Jira, Linear...).

--- What the agent did ---
SAYS I'll start by trying to read the source.
CALL mcp__phase_b__read_source {"source": "rules"}
RESULT Error executing tool read_source: cannot read https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy: the address does not resolve from here
CALL mcp__phase_b__read_source {"source": "https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy"}
RESULT Error executing tool read_source: cannot read https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy: the address does not resolve from here

Deployed version 1-d9ed7a127857fcad is untouched.\n\nHow would you like to go on?", "choices": ["Send a reachable URL or a corrected address", "Paste the policy text or add it as a records/transcripts source", "Skip this source and draft from other sources", "Wait: I'll fix access and ask you to retry"]}
RESULT [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Sent to the owner. They are not at their desk and have not answered yet.'}]
SAYS I couldn't draft from the `rules` source, because I couldn't read it. The address `https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy` doesn't resolve from here. I tried it twice, once by source name and once by URL, and got the same error both times.

I haven't proposed any elements. Each one has to cite the source, and I haven't seen the policy text. I didn't want to guess at lending rules. The deployed version `1-d9ed7a127857fcad` is unchanged.

I've messaged the owner with these options:
- Send a reachable or corrected URL.
- Paste the policy text, or add it as a records or transcripts source.
-
MESSAGES TO THE OWNER [{"to": "owner <owner@library.invalid>", "text": "I can't draft from the \"rules\" source yet. https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy doesn't resolve from here, and I got the same error on two attempts. Deployed version 1-d9ed7a127857fcad is untouched.\n\nHow would you like to go on?", "choices": ["Send a reachable URL or a corrected address", "Paste the policy text or add it as a records/transcripts source", "Skip this source and draft from other sources", "Wait: I'll fix access and ask you to retry"]}]
FINAL ANSWER I couldn't draft from the `rules` source, because I couldn't read it. The address `https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy` doesn't resolve from here. I tried it twice, once by source name and once by URL, and got the same error both times.

I haven't proposed any elements. Each one has to cite the source, and I haven't seen the policy text. I didn't want to guess at lending rules. The deployed version `1-d9ed7a127857fcad` is unchanged.

- Paste the policy text, or add it as a records or transcripts source.
- Skip this source and draft from other sources.
- Wait until access is fixed, then retry.

I'll pick this up once they answer.

content.text: {"passed": true, "why": "The agent tried to read the source, said it couldn't, offered 'Paste the policy text' as one of the options and made no drafts or guesses. It left the decision to the owner, so no must or must-not was violated."}
